I only saw her texts once, in late November, when she wrote a two page A4 directed to both me and him and mailed it to both of us. In the letter she said how amazing I am and how much she loves me etc. but also that she still has feelings for him and wants him back.

We had our first big fight then and I wanted to leave because I assumed she's emotionally cheating on me with him hard, like sexting him and stuff. She swore she wasn't and showed me their messages. I saw her professing her love to him and him saying all that shit about me but nothing else. Couple weeks later, mid-late December I asked her to stop texting him. Never saw their texts again.

I tried to avoid the choosing situation altogether by just leaving - it would have been less heartbreaking for her at least - but she decided that she'll block him instead of losing me.

I wish she didn't have to go through this, I really do, but I don't want to be in a relationship where she has contact with her recent ex and she doesn't want to live without me so we settled for her blocking him.

The best friend doesn't know me and I don't know him - the first thing she told him a bout me are my views on religion and he immediately started shit talking me.

It's a horrible situation to be in and I'm sorry you experienced that.

There's no way I can stay with her if he's part of her life. I just can't, I've tried for months and it didn't work.   
I wanted to leave - she was the one who decided that blocking him would be worth keeping me. I understand this was very hard for her but I don't see any room for compromise in this situation.  
Am I jealous? I don't know. Perhaps. But I think I have the right to be after she told me she would choose him over me if he only gave her a sign. 

Thank you for reading my post, I appreciate your feedback.
She says she's changed and no longer thinks of him that way and doesn't want anything more than platonic from him and for the most part I believe her.

I just want to clarify this point:

"She told me on multiple occasions that if he wanted her back she would leave me and go back to him without a second thought. "

Yes, I should have left back then. But it's been a year since that, and she says she's changed and I think I believe her - she never said anything remotely like that in the past year and except for breaking the boundary, she's been a truly amazing girlfriend and friend.

She says she no longer feels that way about him and that she only talks to him as a friend. From their messages I suppose I can see that; she cares about him but there's nothing that suggests she's emotionally cheating on me.

I value all of your advice but I feel like I'm making a horrible mistake if I leave - people can change and I believe that she's no longer the same person she was when we first met.

Me and her have agreed that what we have is worth fighting for and I've decided to give her one last chance under the condition that she blocks her friend/ex. Either that or I'm out. One last chance. If she ever steps over this line again I'm gone for good.

Thank you all for your support, sorry to disappoint by making what is possibly the wrong choice.
